description.value:
You conjure a 20-foot-radius sphere of poisonous yellow-green fog centered on a point you choose within 120 feet. The fog spreads around corners and heavily obscures its area, lasting for the duration or until dispersed by strong wind.

A creature that enters the cloud for the first time on a turn, or starts its turn there, must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 5d8 poison damage on a failure or half as much on a success; this occurs even if the creature holds its breath or does not need to breathe.

At the start of each of your turns, the cloud rolls 10 feet away from you along the ground, sinking into low areas and openings as it moves.

Overcharge Tech. Cast with a tech slot of 6th level or higher, the poison damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level beyond 5th.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 5
